passive.name: Spirit Abjuration
passive.description: Aurora's spells and attacks exorcise spirits from the enemies she damages. Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.

spells.name: Twofold Hex
spells.description: Aurora sends out a missile that curses any enemies it hits. She can then recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging foes who are hit along the way.
spells.tooltip:
Fire cursed energy in a direction, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage to enemies and cursing them for {{ markduration }} seconds.

Recast: End the curse, drawing back part of the enemy's spirit to Aurora, dealing up to {{ q2damagemax }} magic damage to enemies passed through based on their missing Health. Damage beyond the first hit is reduced to 20%.

If the duration runs out, Aurora will automatically Recast the Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Across the Veil
spells.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time.
spells.tooltip:
Hop in a direction. Upon landing, enter the spirit realm, becoming Invisible for {{ invisduration }} seconds and entering Realm Hopper, gaining {{ movespeedbonus }}% Move Speed.

Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion resets this Ability's Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Weirding
spells.description: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.
spells.tooltip:
Converge the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic dealing {{ damagecalc }} magic damage to enemies in the area and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% decaying over {{ slowduration }} second.

Aurora hops backwards a short distance after casting.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Between Worlds
spells.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.
spells.tooltip:
Leap in a direction. Upon landing, Aurora converges the realms, sending out a pulse of spirit energy that deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage and Slows enemies hit by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% for 2 seconds.

The area of convergence stays active for {{ areaduration }} seconds, granting Aurora Realm Hopper for {{ areaduration }} seconds, allowing her to jump from one edge of the area to another.

Enemies attempting to enter or leave the area are Slowed by {{ exitslowpercent*-100 }}% for {{ stunduration }} seconds.

Aurora can Recast this Ability to end the effect early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Spirit Abjuration
effects: Innate: Aurora's damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Spirit Abjuration to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage equal to 2.5% (+ 2% per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health, capped at 100 : 270 (based on level) against monsters.

Upon consuming the stacks from a champion, Aurora additionally exorcises them, freeing a Spirit from the target that follows her for the same duration. For each active Spirit, Aurora is healed for 3 : 20 (based on level) (+ 2% AP) every second. Subsequent exorcisms free further Spirits and refresh all active Spirits. Aurora may have up to 4 Spirits at a time, for a maximum heal per tick of 12 : 80 (based on level) (+ 8% AP).

variants.name: Twofold Hex
effects: Twofold Hex can be recast after 0.1 seconds while at least one target is marked, and does so automatically at the end of the mark's duration.

variants.name: Across the Veil
effects: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them will reset Across the Veil's cooldown.

variants.name: Between Worlds
effects: Between Worlds can be recast after 1 second of unleashing the shockwave while the rift is active.
Recast: Aurora closes the rift prematurely.
The rift closes immediately if Aurora dies, enters resurrection, leaves the area, or is not within the area upon creation.
